name: Possessed Mortal

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

abilities.name: Frightful Form
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this Threat must make a DN 3 Fear Test.

abilities.name: Burnt Body
abilities.text: Unless prevented from doing so, the Daemon escapes back to the Warp, and the resultant Warp energy explodes from the now empty mortal host. Warp Explosion: 5 +5 ED / Agonising, Blast (6)

determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 4d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.

options.name: Daemonic Gifts: Razor Claws
options.text: Possessed Mortals manifest their transformations in a variety of different ways. Replace the Horrifying Tendril with one of the following options.

options.name: Daemonic Gifts: Scything Talons
options.text: Possessed Mortals manifest their transformations in a variety of different ways. Replace the Horrifying Tendril with one of the following options.

options.name: Wings
options.text: Some Possessed Mortals have wings. Wings: This Threat may clumsily Fly at Speed 10; Athletics (S) Tests may be required for manoeuvring.
